# From a muxt.json directory, the first package whose tests fail ends the
# run: the entries after it are not tested, so their keys never appear.
# go test's output passes through, and muxt adds one line naming the entry.

! muxt test
stdout '(?m)^example\.com/m/a$'
stdout 'FAIL'
! stdout 'example\.com/m/b'
stderr '(?m)^Error: example\.com/m/a: go test failed$'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/m

go 1.24
-- muxt.json --
{
	"packages": {
		"example.com/m/a": [{}],
		"example.com/m/b": [{}]
	}
}
-- a/template.go --
package a

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templateFiles embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templateFiles, "*.gohtml"))
-- a/index.gohtml --
Hello.
-- a/a_test.go --
package a

import "testing"

func TestFails(t *testing.T) {
	t.Fatal("this package fails")
}
-- b/template.go --
package b

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templateFiles embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templateFiles, "*.gohtml"))
-- b/index.gohtml --
Hello.
-- b/b_test.go --
package b

import "testing"

func TestPasses(t *testing.T) {}
